description: Tracks a deBridge order by its order id or by the hash of the transaction that created it: current state (created, fulfilled, unlock in transit, complete, cancelled, refunded) with a plain explanation, whether the funds have already landed on the destination chain, and a link to the order page. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

tx_hash.description: Hash or signature of the source-chain transaction, when the order id is unknown
